units.source_text: “每当气喘、心跳，或是胸口感到压抑的时候……我原以为自己还很年轻呢。

en.t: Whenever I felt short of breath, had palpitations, or felt a tightness in my chest... I had thought I was still young.

units.source_text: 打五十岁起，我就感到年龄不饶人啦！”

en.t: But from the time I turned fifty, I began to feel that age shows no mercy!
